title: Quantitative asphericalization and Gromov's linear bordism problem
summary: We prove a PL bordism version of Gromov's linearity conjecture over a broad class of asphericalization groups for manifolds endowed with faithful representations in all dimensions. Since every group embeds into an asphericalization group, this bordism version of the conjecture holds after allowing the target group to be enlarged. Our results apply in both the oriented and unoriented settings. In the PL category, no bounded local geometry is required.
